summary: Phase E-2 / Prompt 2 (Composition Room & Editorial Workflow UI) — FULL PASS. Backend: 58/58 tests green (47 existing + 11 new in test_phase_e2_p2_editorial_public.py covering public editorial variant endpoint, internal_translation isolation, PATCH autosave, schedule, toolbar surface). Frontend split-pane verified end-to-end with the SuperAdmin account: sidebar 'Editorial Studio' link present, /blueprint/editorial renders ed-rail + ed-pane-empty, 71 masters + 60 variants listed with status dots + market codes + locales, 8 market filter chips + 6 status filter chips (all 5 spine statuses ed-filter-status-{draft, ai_composing, ready_for_editorial_review, scheduled, published} present), Italian status copy used (Bozza · In composizione · Pronto per revisione · Programmata · Pubblicata). Clicking a variant opens ed-pane with both tabs (ed-tab-published, ed-tab-internal), ed-field-title + ed-field-excerpt editable on Published Locale, Preview link href='/en-AE/magazine/<slug>?preview=1' target=_blank exactly as required. Toolbar shows the 3 mandated editorial verbs (Compose Direction · Refine Editorial Angle · Rebalance Hospitality Tone). Forbidden words 'Generate', 'AI', 'GPT', 'Claude' are NOT present anywhere in the editor pane. Internal Understanding tab renders the read-only banner 'REVIEW TRANSLATION — INTERNAL USE ONLY' with ZERO editable inputs/textareas/contenteditable elements (read-only invariant holds). Public endpoint contract verified: GET /api/magazine/public/{tenant}/editorial/{slug} returns 404 when unpublished, returns article-shaped payload when published with _source='editorial_variant' and _locale.source='editorial_variant' + _locale.served=target_locale, and NEVER includes 'internal_translation' (key absence + raw-text leak both checked). Calendar response also stripped. Internal-translation endpoint requires auth (401 anonymous, 200/404 authenticated).

issues: The data-testid 'ed-internal-content' is NOT present in the DOM when the variant has no stored internal_translation (the empty-state with the 'Nessuna comprensione editoriale disponibile' message renders, but without the testid wrapper). The banner ('ed-internal-banner') IS present and the read-only invariant holds (zero editable inputs), so this is a testability gap rather than a functional bug. Recommend always rendering ed-internal-content as the wrapper around either the article body or the empty-state copy.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Render `data-testid=ed-internal-content` even in the empty-state of the Internal Understanding tab, so automated regression can assert read-only invariant unconditionally.
critical_code_review_comments: magazine.py public_editorial_variant: clean two-step resolution (exact locale → any published variant) with internal_translation stripped at _shape_variant_as_article — good defense-in-depth. The performance_signals.public_views increment is wrapped in try/except, won't break a read on write failure. Good.
Frontend toolbar verbs are hard-coded English strings ('Compose Direction', etc.) — intentional per spec (editorial language). Confirmed no leaking of 'Generate/AI/GPT/Claude' across the pane.
Preview URL shape verified at component level: `/<locale>/magazine/<slug>?preview=1` matches the spec exactly; target=_blank is honored.
Status filter chips render the 5 spine statuses as editorial dots (color from STATUS_META.dot) — not Tailwind badges. Confirmed visually.
